summary.display: 6 core routes and 4 focused interactions checked
summary.confidence: High for safe read-only UI behavior; destructive and paid actions deferred

results.title: Operations dashboard
results.observation: Authenticated dashboard loaded and remained on /admin after a hard reload. KPI cards showed users, revenue, recordings and failures, with links to all administrator areas.

results.title: User management
results.observation: User table loaded, the dedicated administrator was found by email search, and the route remained authenticated after reload.

results.title: User-row processing link
results.observation: The row action navigated to /admin/processing?user=<uuid>, but Processing Monitor still displayed all users; the user query parameter was ignored.

results.title: Question management and search
results.observation: Question table loaded, search for 'earliest childhood' returned the expected single active question, and the route survived reload.

results.title: Create-question dialog
results.observation: Add Question opened a labeled modal with question text, domain, order, duration, status and optional tip fields plus Cancel/Create/Close controls. The dialog was closed without creating data.

results.title: Icon-button accessibility
results.observation: Multiple row-action and drag-handle buttons exposed no accessible name, preventing reliable screen-reader identification and weakening keyboard/automation semantics.

results.title: Processing monitor
results.observation: Monitor loaded with status controls, failed-job warning, auto-refresh controls and per-user rows; it remained authenticated after reload. Process, retry and trigger actions were deliberately not invoked in production.

results.title: Payments search and controls
results.observation: Payment search filtered john@example.com to the expected succeeded Premium payment and the route survived reload, but no refund control or refund workflow is present in the administrator UI.

results.title: Operational logs
results.observation: Logs loaded with failure/audit type control and populated failure records, and remained authenticated after reload. Mutation audit coverage is separately disproved by the API verification.

results.title: Desktop layout and route persistence
results.observation: At a 1280-pixel viewport, all six routes showed the expected H1 after direct navigation and reload, and no route produced document-level horizontal overflow.
